items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I think we had two or three saxes, because Dave Weinstein also played sax.

ctx.x: Well, let's see, wait a minute.
I think we had two or three saxes, because Dave Weinstein also played sax. Now, I don't remember whether we had two saxes or three saxes on that section.
